# Off The Trail

Off The Trail is a boutique mountain hospitality brand based in Dalhousie, Himachal Pradesh, India.

## Current Properties

### Dalhousie Estate (Open)
- **Location:** Bakrota Ridge, Dalhousie, Himachal Pradesh, India (elevation: 6,800 ft / 2,073 m)
- **Type:** 10-room boutique mountain retreat / boutique hotel
- **URL:** https://offthetrail.in/stays/dalhousie
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 98163 15898 | https://wa.me/919816315898
- **Check-in:** 1:00 PM | **Check-out:** 11:00 AM

### Room Categories & Pricing (inclusive of breakfast)
| Room Type      | Price per night |
|----------------|----------------|
| Standard Room  | ₹3,200          |
| Deluxe Room    | ₹4,000          |
| Super Deluxe   | ₹4,800          |

Extra adult / child above 6 years: ₹1,200/night (with extra bed + breakfast)

### Amenities
- Breakfast included with every room booking (served 8:00 AM – 10:30 AM)
- High-speed fiber Wi-Fi (50+ Mbps) — bedrooms, balconies, and common areas
- Free on-site parking (direct paved road access, no trekking required)
- Private balconies on most room categories
- In-house mountain kitchen — Himachali and North Indian meals to order
- Electric room heaters, quilts, and electric bed warmers for cold nights
- 24/7 hot water in en-suite bathrooms
- Evening bonfire on ridge terrace (seasonal)

### Policies
- **Cancellation:** Free cancellation 7+ days before check-in (100% refund). Within 7 days: 1-night retention charge; balance refunded.
- **Payment:** UPI accepted (offthetrail@upi). Share UTR + receipt on WhatsApp for confirmation.

### Getting There
- Pathankot Railway Junction (nearest broad-gauge): 82 km, ~2.5–3 hours drive
- Gaggal Airport, Dharamshala (nearest airport): 105 km, ~3.5 hours drive
- Road: All-weather metalled road leads directly to estate gate

## Other Services

### Adventures & Activities (near Dalhousie)
- Guided treks, paragliding at Bir Billing, zipline, local village walks

### Mountain Café
- In-house café at the Dalhousie Estate — filter coffee, local snacks
- URL: https://offthetrail.in/cafe
